description: This is an API route module implemented using FastAPI, defining endpoints for user authentication functions such as registration, login, profile retrieval, update, and token refresh. It manages user-related operations interacting with database repositories and models.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest = Body(..., description="Registration payload"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, checks for email and username uniqueness, hashes password, creates user, and returns minimal user info.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, verifies email and password, returns a mock JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated/mock user based on trusted user info.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile of the currently trusted user using provided data.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a new mock access token for the trusted user.
